waves.scope: Homogeneous4gameB/Wwaves, same4seedslots forpairedroles, rotateB/Wwaveorder. Explicit6totalparticipantsin6logicalCPUs includesowner; testbudgetonlynotdefault. Physicalcores12-15+siblings28-31remainavailableOS.

cli_evidence: LatestCommandLine.cpp devrandom-games supportscompute/gradient/map/matchup/tickscap; no --profile-dir. Uses isolatedGLOB2_USER_DIR/GLOB2_USER_DATA_DIR+SDLdummy andfreshprofile only, existingconfigs untouched. Legacyobserverdriver yieldscontrollers9/12 retained.
timing_policy: No per-tick checksum telemetry enabled, no optionaldiagnostic fields/timers. Wholewait4 processCPU/e2e alongsideHISTORYinnerwall. Optionalnaturalsidecars/HISTORYchecksum read afterrun ifavailable; absentnotproofequivalence.
caps_policy: 1hwall cap dominatesstatus evenifSIGTERMreturns0 orwinnerappearsnearboundary. Preservepartialsummary/CPU/logs; capsreportseparately, notsuccessfulwinners orzerotime. Pairedtimingseligibleonlybothwinnerswithmatchingticks/winner, optionalchecksumifbothpresent.
gate: Root decides whether this largecohort is warranted AFTER latestWconfirmation. Explicitreview/rootapproval/exactsource+plan+resolvedpostbuildbinaryhashes/campaignT+starttime/exclusivelock/noothergames/controllers. Launcherdoesnotpauseorresumeongoingcampaign, build, orreuseoldmeasurements.
statistics: 32pairedseedsindependentunits,onegame/role/seed,norepeatwarmups. Fixedseed10000pairedbootstrap only oneligiblepairs; caps/excludedseedsreport. Per-gameTPSmean vsratioofaggregateticks/sumgamewall vsactualhomogeneouswavemakespan distinguish; interleavedoverallcampaignnotperrolecausalspan. No exact32^32enumeration. Waves report both requested seed bootstrap and paired4seed wave-cluster interval(8clusters/map) to expose shared host-window dependence.
